repairs.diagnosis: The pipeline sets random_state only on RandomForestClassifier, but the worker's repeated-prediction determinism check fails because the pipeline is not fully seeded: the OneHotEncoder and the overall estimator construction rely on global RNG state, and n_jobs=2 can introduce thread-scheduling nondeterminism in prediction. The constructor program must make every stochastic component explicitly seeded and avoid parallel nondeterminism.
repairs.fix: In build_pipeline, set random_state=task_spec['seed'] on OneHotEncoder (and any other stochastic transformer), and set n_jobs=1 on RandomForestClassifier so prediction is single-threaded and reproducible. Keep the existing random_state on the classifier.

repairs.diagnosis: OneHotEncoder does not accept a random_state argument in the installed scikit-learn version; the constructor call passes an unsupported keyword, causing worker execution to fail before fitting.
repairs.fix: Remove random_state=task_spec['seed'] from the OneHotEncoder(...) call in the ColumnTransformer, leaving OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore').
